hypotheses.reasoning: At 03:10:47 notification-svc hot-reloaded config revision 796 changing TEMPLATE_SVC_URL to http://template-svc.internal:9090. Every request to /render before that worked (e.g. #116). The first failure was 74s later at #132, and from then on every render call got ECONNREFUSED on port 9090. Template-svc stayed alive and healthy the whole time: it kept logging GC lines (#133, #145) with normal heap, and it logged no errors. It simply stopped receiving /render requests. A connection refused on a host that is otherwise up points to the wrong port in the new URL, not to template-svc being down. The gateway 503s (#134, #147) are downstream of this.
Template-svc's listener on 9090 may have stopped while the process kept running. This is unlikely, because the timing matches the config change exactly and template-svc logged no errors or restarts.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll back notification-svc config to the revision before 796 (restore the previous TEMPLATE_SVC_URL, with the correct port), or push a fixed value and confirm /render calls succeed. Then add validation or a canary check for config-service changes to service endpoint URLs.
